Commentary.Commentary: The pitch still looks to good to bat on and India are the clear favourites to win. However, as we saw in the last game, one spell can turn things around. The dark clouds are still hovering over the ground and let's hope that they stay away and we get on with the second innings. Join us back for the chase!

Jasprit Bumrah was once again the tormentor-in-chief for the visitors. His figures read - 10-2-27-5! Axar Patel was tight and scalped a wicket as well while Hardik Pandya and man with the golden arm, Kedar Jadhav were the others with a wicket to their name. Bhuvneshwar Kumar was once again wicketless but was economical and so was Yuzvendra Chahal. India's fielding though was very ordinary today and Kohli would be very disappointed with that.

Once that stand was broken, the Lankan collapse started. Thirimanne tried to anchor the innings but in process to up the ante, he lost his wicket. Milinda Siriwardana's cameo lower down the order ensured that Sri Lanka go past the 200-run mark.

In the end Sri Lanka have done well to get near 220! However, it was another dismal batting performance from them. Niroshan Dickwella failed to get the hosts off to a flier and then Kusal Mendis' wicket soon after meant Dinesh Chandimal and Lahiru Thirimanne had to resurrect the innings. Both of them were slow to take off but stitched a valuable 72-run stand. The latter completed his third consecutive half century while the former failed to convert his start.

Full outside off, Fernando drives it powerfully through left of mid off. Jadhav there dives to his left and gets a hand to it. The ball slows down and Kedar can chase it down. A brace to end the innings. SRI LANKA FINISH ON 217/9!
On a length outside off, Malinga hangs his bat in the air and gets an outside edge towards third man. A single is taken.

Four Byes! Awkward bounce! Slower one outside off, another play and a miss from Malinga. The ball bounces in front of Dhoni and just takes off from the turf. He is lucky that he doesn't hit him on the face. The ball races behind and four byes are signalled.
Pitched outside off, Malinga looks to put bat on ball but is outfoxed by the slow-paced delivery.
Length delivery around off, defended well.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Slower one outside off, Fernando fails to put bat on ball.
Short outside off, Vishwa goes for the hook but it's too quick for him.
Lasith Malinga is the last man in.

OUT! Chameera is way short of his crease! Banged in short, angling down leg. It's too short and Dhoni leaps to his left to grab the ball. Fernando from the other end takes off but Chameera hesitates a touch. He finally decides to go for the run but is late. Dhoni throws the ball to Bhuvneshwar, who collects the ball and whips the bails off. The umpire signals wide and then refers it upstairs. The replays show Chameera to be run out.
The umpire has gone upstairs to refer the run out appeal against Chameera. He seems to be short of his crease by miles but still the umpire doesn't want to take any risks.
Banged in short, Chameera makes room to hook it away but misses.
Very full on middle, driven hard through mid on. Kohli in the deep sprints towards the ball and keeps them down to one.
Wide outside off, squeezed through covers for a single.

FOUR! Pierced! Back of a length delivery, angling in, Chameera throws kitchen sink at it. Connects it off the meat and the ball races through backward square leg for a boundary. Bhuvneshwar Kumar is having an off day!
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Full outside off, bunted over covers for a couple.
Vishwa Fernando is the new man in.

OUT! Bumrah has the last laugh! Maiden 5-fer for him as well! Once again Siriwardana tries to go after Bumrah, makes room to smash but misses. And, the ball sneaks through the rattle the woodwork. This is a timely wicket for India as Siriwardana had started to look dangerous. 11th wicket in the series for Jasprit and that's the highest by any Indian bowler in Sri Lanka.
Wide! Length delivery outside leg, Siriwardana sways away from the line and gets a wide.

FOUR! 200 up for Sri Lanka! Full around off, Siriwardana makes room and plays it inside out over covers. That's a fabulous shot and the ball goes on the bounce across the fence. Back-to-back boundaries and that will spoil Bumrah's figures. Siriwardana was the one who resurrected the Lankan innings in the last game and is doing the same this time around as well.
FOUR! This time Siriwardana connects! A touch fuller around middle and leg, Siriwardana clears his front leg and slogs it over square leg for a boundary. Valuable runs, these!
Siriwardana makes room, Bumrah follows him with a slower one. The slower one does Milinda in and he misses his slog and gets rapped on the pads.
The rain gods have showed mercy on us as the weather has cleared. The players are back on the field. Three overs are left in the innings and Jasprit Bumrah to continue.

Oh no... here comes the rain! There was a threat of a thundershower later in the evening and dare we say, it has come on time. The umpires do not waste any time in bringing the covers on and the entire square is covered. It does look a bit heavy.

Another bouncer outside off, Chameera sways away from it. That shall be another maiden in this innings. This time from Bhuvneshwar Kumar and that too in the 47th over. Sums up the Lankan innings perfectly.
Short outside off, Chameera goes for the pull but misses.
A similar delivery and once again Chameera goes after it. The ball brushes the pads and goes to the keeper.
Angling down leg, Chameera goes after it but misses. The ball brushes the pads and goes towards the keeper.
Banged in short, Chameera goes for the hook but misses it completely.
Full outside off, Chameera defends it off the front foot.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar is back on.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Dushmantha Chameera is the new man in. A slip is in place now!

OUT! Back-to-back 4-fers for Jasprit Bumrah! He becomes the first Indian to secure back-to-back 4-fers in ODIs against Sri Lanka! Bowls a cutter around middle, Dananjaya gives it a big swing but misses and the ball crashes onto the stumps. The variation proved to be too good for the tailender. 10 wickets in the series and this is his personal best as well!
Beaten! On a good length outside off, Dananjaya feels for it but gets beaten.
The batsman picked that bouncer early and let it through to the keeper. Mixing it up nicely!
Outside off, pushed to covers.

Back of a length delivery, angling in, Siriwardana goes for the pull but gets it off the pads on the leg side. The batsmen scamper through. The umpire gives it as a run so there might be some bat involved.
Jasprit Bumrah is back on.
Tossed up outside off, pushed through covers for a single.
Full on middle, swept behind square leg for a single.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Slogged away! Tossed up on middle, Siriwardana kneels down and slog sweeps it in front of square on the leg side for a boundary.

Run out chance! Tossed up around leg, Dananjaya turns it on the leg side and takes off for a single. Chahal chases it down and has a shy at the bowler's end. Akila puts in a desperate dive and completes the single as the throw misses the stumps. Replays show that a direct hit would have had Dananjaya.
Tossed up around off, eased down to long off for a single.
Akila Dananjaya walks out to bat.

OUT! Timber! In trying to up the ante, Kapugedera departs! Full and straight on middle, the Lankan skipper makes room to hammer it but misses it completely. The ball sneaks through and knock off the leg pole. Another batsman departs and Sri Lanka are failing to stitch some partnerships here. Patel has his first one of the game!
Full on middle and leg, Siriwardana kneels down and slogs it on the bounce to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Almost chopped on! Arm ball around off, Siriwardana looks to guide it late but gets an bottom edge which goes just past the off pole.
Full outside off, Kapugedera clears his front leg and bunts it on the bounce to Dhawan at sweeper cover. A single is taken.
Full outside off, tonked through mid off for a single.
Sliding into the pads, nudged on the leg side.

Fired full outside off, Siriwardana drives it powerfully past the diving extra cover fielder. Bhuvneshwar from long off, runs across to his right and keeps the Lankans down to just a single. That is poor running from the duo.
The batsman has driven it through mid off. They pick up a single.
Googly around leg, Milinda looks to defend it on the leg side but gets a leading edge in the cover region. A quick single is taken.
Tossed up on middle, clipped uppishly through wide mid on for a single.
The batsman opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Tossed up, spinning away, Siriwardana looks to drive but misses.
Yuzvendra Chahal is back on.
Full outside off, Siriwardana opens the face of the bat and drives it through covers for a single.
The batsman has driven it straight down the ground, where Axar dives to his left to make the stop.
Sliding down leg, Siriwardana just nudges it fine down the leg side. Bumrah from short fine leg, runs behind it and keeps the batsmen down to a brace.
Arm ball around off, chopped to cover.
Sliding into the batsman, turned to mid-wicket.
Wide! Darts it down the leg side. Siriwardana kneels down to paddle sweep but misses. The umpire spreads his arms to signal wide.

FOUR! Streaky! Flat and straight around off, Siriwardana goes back to punch but gets a healthy outside edge. It flies past Dhoni and to the third man fence. If there had been a slip, it would have been a catching opportunity.
Halt in play as Kapugedara is been given a massage from the team physio. Meanwhile, Axar Patel comes back on.
FOUR! Creamed it! Full outside off, Kapugedera leans into the shot and drives it crisply through wide mid off for a boundary. That was a glorious shot!
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Fullish outside off, pushed through covers for a single.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. They pick up a single.
On a length outside off, dabbed to point.
Full outside off, pushed off the front foot on the off side.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar is back on.
Powerplay 3 has been signalled! Now, a maximum of 5 fielders can stay outside the ring.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Milinda gets behind the line and blocks it. Another superb over from Bumrah, a single and a wicket from it!
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Banged in short outside off, Siriwardana sways away from the ball.
Milinda Siriwardana walks out to bat.

OUT! Soft dismissal! Fuller on middle and leg, Thirimanne looks to flick it over Jadhav at mid-wicket. Fails to get the required elevation and the ball flies straight to the Kedar, who takes it with ease in a reverse cup. Bumrah strikes again, completes yet another 3-fer! A good knock from Lahiru comes to an end. He was the one who was anchoring the innings and Sri Lanka will have to get their act back.
Back of a length delivery outside off, run down to third man for a single.
Beaten! On a good length outside off, holds its line and skids on. Kapugedera plays for the angle but gets beaten.
Full outside off, knocked down to long off for a single.
Full down the leg side, paddle swept to fine leg for a single.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Thirimanne kneels down and goes for a hard slog, gets it off the inner half and the ball runs towards deep square leg. A single is taken.
Full and straight on middle, turned to mid-wicket.
Axar Patel replaces Jadhav.

FOUR! Cut away! Patel drops it short and wide outside off, Thirimanne goes back and cuts it fiercely through point for a boundary. This is the first one conceded by Axar! Thirimanne moves to his highest-ever score against India.
Angling into the batsman, Chamara fails to flick it away and gets rapped on the pads. A muted appeal is turned down. Excellent over, just a run from it!
Back of a length delivery outside off, chopped to point.
Another slower one on a length around middle, Thirimanne waits for it and then dabs on the off side. A single is taken.
Slower one very full around off, defended with soft hands on the off side.
On a good length, angling across. Thirimanne looks to cut but gets an inside edge towards Dhoni, who times his jump well to hold onto the ball.
Length delivery around leg, tucked to mid-wicket.
Jasprit Bumrah comes back on.
Leg bye! Thirimanne looks to nudge the arm ball but misses. The ball brushes the pads and rolls on the leg side. A leg bye is taken.
Thirimanne kneels down and looks to paddle it, gets it off the inner half towards fine leg. Another brace results.
Arm ball, sliding down leg, tickled behind square on the leg side for a single.
Sliding into the pads, turned on the leg side.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. One run added to the total.
Straighter one outside off, eased down to long off for a single.
Arm ball, angling into the batsman, flicked on the leg side.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Angling into the batsman, knocked down to long on for a single.
Driven through the covers by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Sliding into the pads, worked fine down the leg side.
Pushed to covers off the back foot.
Axar Patel replaces Chahal!

Jadhav bowls a round-arm delivery, slides it in from around off. Thirimanne looks to defend with bat and pad close but gets an inside edge onto the pads. Hang on, the replays show that it was pad first. However, impact was umpire's call and a review wouldn't have helped India's cause.
Chamara gets off the mark with a sweep through backward square leg for a single.
Wide Slides it down the leg side. Kapugedera misses his flick and a wide is signalled.
Skipper Chamara Kapugedera is the new man in.

OUT! That was plumb! Decision stays! Tossed up on middle, straightens a touch after pitching. Mathews goes for the reverse paddle but misses. Gets rapped on the front pad and the players appeal. The umpire raises his finger straightaway. Mathews after a discussion with Thirimanne goes for the review. Ultra Edge doesn't spot any involvement of the bat and the Hawk Eye shows three reds. Mathews has to depart. He has only himself to blame on this as it was a poor choice of shot from the ex-Lankan skipper. The man with the golden arm, Jadhav has struck one again.
Mathews has played a needless shot and paid the price as he has been adjudged lbw. The Lankan though has opted for the review. That looked plumb to the naked eye.
Full around off, eased down to long off for a single.
Sliding into the batsman, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
Tossed up around middle and leg, Lahiru milks down to long on for a single.
Mathews this time eases down to long on for a single.
Sensible stuff! Follows the maximum by knocking down to long on for a single.

SIX! Into the stands! Thirimanne decides that it's time to up the ante. Dances down and clobbers it with the spin over cow corner. It sails over the fence for a maximum. That was a great shot and hitting with the spin helped his cause.
Tossed up outside off, pushed to covers.
Googly from Chahal, around off, Thirimanne goes for a reverse paddle but misses. Gets hit low on the pads and a muted appeal is turned down.
Drinks break!
Almost Jadhav spoilt his good over. Dropped it short and Thirimanne camped back to pull it through mid-wicket for a single.
Thirimanne dances down the track but only manages to places it back to the bowler. 5 dot balls from Jadhav. Gold stuff, this!
Bowls slightly round-armish, Lahiru goes back and places it to covers.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Once more it's dropped short outside off, Thirimanne goes back and cuts but finds the man at point.
Shortish outside off, punched off the back foot to covers.
Kedar Jadhav comes into the attack. Will his golden arm do the trick for India?
Thirimanne dances down and eases it to long off for a single.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. They pick up a single. 1000 ODI runs against India. 10th Sri Lankan to do so.

FOUR! Asking to be hit and is put away! Chahal bowls a slider but drops it short. Mathews latches onto this in a flash, rocks back and pulls it hard over mid-wicket. The ball bounces just before the fence and a boundary results. This was a rare poor delivery from Chahal.
Thirimanne stays in the crease and punches it down to long off for a single.
A touch shorter around off, punched in the cover region for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Fuller this time, spinning in, Lahiru kneels down and paddle sweeps it through short fine leg for a brace.
Short around off, skidding on, cut away but straight to Dhawan.
Spinning in from around off, turned towards square leg.
Knocked down to long on off the back foot for a single.
Patel bowls a touch round-armish, pitches it full outside off, tapped back to the bowler.
Thirimanne kneels down and paddle sweeps it fine down the leg side for a single.
Shortish delivery, sits up nicely for Thirimanne, who pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Back of a length delivery outside off, dabbed towards point for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Banged in short and angling down leg, Mathews goes for the hook but misses. Pandya hears some sound and appeals but is the only one appealing.
Back of a length delivery outside off, punched off the back foot to covers.

17th ODI fifty for Lahiru Thirimanne! Back of a length delivery wide outside off, Thirimanne waits for it and just glides it down to third man for a single. Gets to his half century and it's his third consecutive one against India. What a comeback it has been from him, absolutely superb! He is the only Lankan batsman who has looked good out in the middle.
Straying on the pads, tickled towards long leg for a single.
A touch shorter and straighter, tapped back to the bowler.
Full and sliding in, Mathews makes room and throws the kitchen sink at it. Gets it off the inner half past the leg pole and behind square leg for a single. He is not looking in the groove at all.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Arm ball around leg, milked down to long on for a single.
Short and wide outside off, chopped to point.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
Fuller on the pads, flicked behind square on the leg side for a single.

FOUR! Release shot! Full and straight on the pads, Thirimanne slogs it across. Doesn't connect it cleanly but still finds the gap in the square leg region. Much-needed boundary this for the Islanders. Thirimanne moves to 46 with this!
Straying on the pads, worked in front of square on the leg side.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Back of a length delivery, angling away, tapped in the cover-point region.
That shall be a maiden for Axar Patel! Straight on off, defended off the front foot. Sri Lanka shouldn't go into a shell here.
Slightly shortish outside off, placed to point. Another dot ball!
Sliding into the batsman, Mathews fails to work it away but misses and gets rapped on the pads.
Full and straight around off, punched back to the bowler.
Another push back to the bowler.
Straighter on middle, knocked back to the bowler.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Tucked through square leg for a single.
Angelo Mathews is the new man in. Sri Lanka will have to build the innings again now.

OUT! Pandya gets rid of Chandimal! Back of a length delivery, angling in. Chandimal looks to pull it away but misjudges the length. Gets a top edge and the ball flies straight to Bumrah at deep square leg. The Indian pacer doesn't make any mistake and gobbles the catch. There was a great battle going on between Pandya and Chandimal and it was the all-rounder who had the last laugh. Dinesh's struggling knock comes to an end. End of a 72-run stand!
Worked off the hips through square leg for a single.
Tickled down to fine leg by the batsman. One run added to the total.
On the thigh pad, tucked away on the leg side for a single.
Punched to mid on off the back foot.

Dhoni has given Chandimal a life! Sliding into the batsman, worked with the angle in the mid-wicket region. Dinesh takes off for a quick single but Thirimanne after taking a couple of steps ahead, sends him back. Rahul rushes to the ball and darts in a low throw towards Dhoni, who reaches out and tries to deflect it onto the stumps. Misses and ends up knocking the stumps off his gloves. Had he collected it and whipped the bails off, Chandimal's dive would have gone in vain. However, he doesn't and the Lankan Test skipper gets a reprieve. It has been a poor show from the Indians on the field today.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Angling into the batsman, flicked to mid-wicket.
Arm ball wide outside off, placed to cover-point.
Short and wide outside off, cut behind square on the off side for a single.
FOUR! Pulled away! Back of a length delivery, angling down leg, sits up nicely for Chandimal, who pulls it with authority through mid-wicket for a boundary. He is growing in confidence.
Dabbed to point from within the crease.

In the air... but safe! Length delivery, angling in, Chandimal looks to pull it away but is not in control of it. Gets a top edge and the ball flies over Kohli at mid-wicket. The Indian skipper sprints after it but still can't get to the ball. Chandimal survives and adds another couple to his score.
Back of a length delivery outside off, tapped in front of covers.
More of the short stuff from Pandya. Thirimanne camps back and pulls it behind square on the leg side. It goes on a bounce to Kumar in the deep. A single is taken.
Back of a length delivery, angling away, Thirimanne gets on the top of the bounce and taps it to point.
WIDE. A length ball down the leg side, Thirimanne cannot get it away.
Hardik Pandya is back on.
The batsman dances down the track and does well to block the ball.
Down the leg side, swept very fine for a single.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
Full and down the leg side, swept through fine leg for a couple.
On middle and leg, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
Comes down the track but is forced to defend.
Short and outside off, cut through point for a single.
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Outside off, Lahiru looks to defend but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads. The ball rolls behind but misses the stumps.
Full and outside off, Thirimanne looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge which flies behind point. Two runs taken.
Slides it full outside off, pushed through covers for a single.
Thirimanne presents another solid front foot defence.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full on middle, turned through mid-wicket. Rahul once again misfields and concedes a single. The fielding has been poor from the Indians.
Pushed off the front foot to mid off.
Short and wide outside off, cut through cover-point for a single.
Axar Patel comes in, replacing Pandya! So spin from both ends now.
Thirimanne dances down the track and milks down to long off for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
50-run stand is up between Chandimal and Thirimanne!

Chance of a run out, but Rahul fails to pick the ball. Tossed up around leg, Chandimal skips down and knocks towards mid on. They take off for a quick single, taking on Lokesh there. The Indian youngster fails to make a clean stop and the batsmen steal a single. 50-run stand is up as well! The duo though needs to carry on this good work!
Tossed up on middle and leg, Thirimanne dances down and eases the ball to long on for a single.
The batsman gets to the pitch of the ball and blocks it.
Leg spinner around off, tapped to cover.
Short and angling away, Thirimanne rides the bounce and cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks in time to let that one go over him.

FOUR! That's class! Full outside off, Thirimanne plants his front foot ahead, leans into the shot and drives it ever so crisply. Gets it through mid off for a boundary. Straight drives are always pleasing to the eyes!
Outside off, left alone!
Well played! Short outside off, Chandimal gets across and plays a controlled pull through square leg. A single is taken.
Wide! Predictable stuff from Pandya. He bangs it short but puts too much effort on it. The ball sails over Chandimal's head and a wide is signalled.
Short and wide outside off, slapped through backward point for a single.

Lbw shout! But, it's going down leg! Once more it's googly from Chahal which Chandimal fails to pick. He prods forward to defend but gets undone by the wrong 'un. Gets rapped on the pads and the players appeal. The umpire stays put though!
Tossed up on middle, turned in the mid-wicket region. Rohit Sharma there misfields and Chandimal looks to steal a single. However, Thirimanne spots Pandya backing up and sends back his teammate.
Chandimal presents a solid front foot defence.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Chandimal too dances down and drives it on the full to long off for a single.
Thirimanne dances down the track and knocks it through mid off for a single.

Excellent bowling this! Pandya is probing Chandimal with some nasty short deliveries. It's another well-directed short delivery. Rises onto Chandimal, who fends it off the splice on the off side. Dinesh had taken his eyes off the ball this time around.
Back of a length delivery outside off, defended tentatively on the off side.

A typical fast bowler stuff from Pandya! After seeing the batsman hurt, he bangs it short again around off. Chandimal gets his bat high to defend and is lucky that it didn't hit the same spot. This time got it off the splice as the bottom hand came off.

Chandimal is in a lot of pain and has called on for the team physio! The ball hit his right thumb and that can be really painful. The physio is making sure that he is fine to continue and Chandimal gets the nod to stay out in the middle.

Ouch! Short delivery around middle, bounces a touch extra, rises onto Chandimal and he fails to fend it out. Hits the thumb and deflects onto the grille of his helmet. He is pain and his partner and Rohit Sharma has gathered around to check on him. The team physio also has rushed out in the middle.
Pandya comes from around the wicket, pitches it up outside off, Lahiru prods forward and taps it through covers for a single.
FOUR! Poor line, punished! Full but on the pads. Easy pickings for Thirimanne as he flicks it fine down the leg side. The fielder there is a lot squarer and so a boundary results.

Time for Drinks! India started off brilliantly with Bumrah scalping two. Since then though, Thirimanne and Chandimal have steadied the ship. Can this pair carry on or will India get a breakthrough? We have seen the momentum changing after a break in play. Let's see what happens today...
Tossed up around off, driven back to the bowler.
Served around leg, worked with the spin towards fine leg for a single.

Edged but away! Googly from Chahal, outside off, Thirimanne prods forward to defend. Gets a thick outside edge and the ball races past first slip. The backward point fielder chases it down and keeps the batsmen to a couple.
Once again Chandimal dances down, converts the flighted delivery to a low full toss and eases it down to long on for a single.
This time Thirimanne uses his feet, skips down and knocks the ball on the full to long on for a single.
Quicker through the air on middle and off, Chandimal dances down and milks down to long off for a single.
Short and wide outside off, Chandimal stands on one leg slaps it through covers. Bumrah is there in the deep and so only a single results.
Fuller this time from Pandya, pushed off the front foot to mid off.
Slightly shortish around off, cracked through point for a single.
Leg bye! Straying on the pads, Chandimal fails to flick it away and the ball brushes the thigh pad and rolls away. A leg bye is taken.
Back of a length delivery, angling away, punched by getting on his toes through covers for a single.
Ohhhh... That went through Thirimanne's defence! On a good length outside off. Lahiru gets forward to defend but the ball sneaks through the gap between bat and pad to Dhoni.
Confusion in the middle! Served fuller on middle, clipped with soft hands in the mid-wicket region. Chandimal takes off for a single but is sent back by his partner in time. The danger is avoided.
Tossed up again outside off, Thirimanne steps down a touch and drives it through wide mid off for a single.
Flighted outside off, Thirimanne pushes it off the front foot to covers.
Tossed up nicely around off, knocked down to long off for a single.
Googly from Chahal around middle and leg. Chandimal prods ahead to defend but fails to pick it and gets rapped on the pads. A muted appeal is turned down.
Tossed up on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Good length delivery, angling away, dabbed to point.
Length delivery, angling away, Lahiru gets across and punches it to wide mid on.
Full outside off, Thirimanne presents a solid front foot defence back to the bowler.
FOUR! Beautiful! Full around off, Thirimanne gets across and flicks it crisply through the gap between mid on and mid-wicket for a boundary. He picked the gap beautifully there!
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Length delivery outside off, Thirimanne gets in the position early and places it off the back foot through point for a single.
Hardik Pandya comes on to bowl, replacing Kumar.
Slightly shortish, punched off the back foot to covers.
Flighted around off, spinning in, Lahiru comes half forward and eases it down to long on for a single.
Thirimanne prods ahead and blocks it away.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full around leg, clipped in front of square on the leg side.
Tossed up around leg, turned on the leg side.
Yuzvendra Chahal is introduced into the attack.

Loud shout for caught behind! Shortish around off, swinging away. Chandimal looks to glide it away but misses. As the ball lands in Dhoni's gloves, the players appeal but the umpire isn't interested. Kumar wants a review but Dhoni isn't sure. Kohli goes with his ex-skipper on this one and doesn't take the review.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Banged in short around off, Chandimal sways away from the ball at the last moment.
FOUR! Edged and over! Short and angling in, Chandimal goes for the hook. Gets a top edge and the ball sails over the keeper's head. It goes on a couple of bounces across the fence for a boundary.

Shout for lbw! Kohli is excited but Dhoni says impact to be outside off. Coming to the delivery it was on a length outside off, Chandimal gets across to defend but got beaten and rapped on the knee roll. Kumar appeals but it's turned down. It's the right decision as the replay shows there was an inside edge.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Chandimal gets on his toes and blocks it.
POWERPLAY 2 has been signalled. 4 fielders allowed outside the circle till the 40th over.
Outside off, left alone.
Slanting away from the batsman, Thirimanne prods forward and looks to play it with the angle but misses. Dhoni dives to his left to grab the ball.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Another play and a miss! A similar delivery, seaming away from the southpaw. Lahiru feels for it but is beaten.
Back of a length delivery, angling away from Thirimanne. It moves away after pitching as well and beats the outside edge of Lahiru's bat, who is drawn forward in defence.
On the pads, flicked behind square on the leg side for a single.
Dabbed to point from within the crease.
Back of a length delivery around off, tapped off the back foot to mid off for a single.
Wide! Banged in short, once again Chandimal ducks under it. The square leg umpire signals it as a wide for height. Slightly harsh call, this!
Full and angling into the pads, clipped nicely but straight to Chahal at mid-wicket.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Bouncer! Chandimal ducks under it and lets it sail to the keeper.

FOUR! More sloppy work in the field! Once again it's off Bhuvneshwar's bowling and his new-ball partner is the culprit. Pitched wide outside off, Chandimal slashes hard at it and gets a thick outside edge. The ball races towards the third man region, where Jasprit makes a hash of an easy stop and concedes a boundary. This is third time that an Indian fielder has fumbled in that region.
Full and straight from Bumrah, it's flicked away for a single.
Straying on the pads, worked behind square leg for a single.
Lahiru Thirimanne strides out to bat, replacing Mendis.

OUT! A stunning catch from Rohit Sharma! Simply superb! Bumrah pitches it on a length around off. Mendis flirts with it, get an outside edge and it flies to the right of Sharma at second slip. The Indian opener leaps to his right and grabs it safely with both the hands. One of the best catches you must have seen in this tournament. This is his 100th International catch! Bumrah kept probing Mendis with this line and he completely deserved this wicket. Another failure for Kusal!
On a length around off, Chandimal looks to play it across the line but gets a soft leading edge in the cover-point region. Another quick single is taken.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Bumrah tries to bowl a slower one but ends up bowling a low full toss on middle and off. It's pushed with soft hands towards mid on and a single is taken. Mendis is finally off the mark!
Now, Bhuvneshwar Kumar bowls a maiden! Pitches it fuller outside off, pushed to covers.
Full outside off, pushed off the front foot on the off side.
Short around off, Chandimal goes for the wild pull but misses it completely.
Angling into the batsman, once again Dinesh fails to work it across and is hit on the thigh pad.

Four Leg byes! Slanting down leg, Chandimal gets inside the line and looks to tuck it away. The ball brushes the pads and runs behind. Dhoni dives to his left but fails to stop it. The ball rolls away to the fence and four leg byes are signalled.
Banged in short around off, Chandimal ducks under it and lets it to the keeper.
Back-to-back maidens from Jasprit Bumrah! He is backing his performance in the last game with another superb spell. Bowls it on a length around off and it's defended from within the crease.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Shout for lbw, turned down! On a good length around off, nips in. Mendis is undone by the sharp inward movement and gets rapped on the knee roll. Bumrah shouts for lbw but the umpire stays put.
Shortish around off, seams away sharply. Mendis looks to play at it but the ball moving away whizzes past the bat. Another play and a miss from Mendis.
A touch ahead of a length around off, Mendis makes another forward block.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Mendis feels for it but gets beaten.  Playing inside the line saved him there.
Dinesh presents another front foot defence to see off the over.
Chandimal stays behind the line of the delivery and then blocks it.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full outside off, pushed to mid off.
FOUR! Glorious! Full and wide outside off, Chandimal plants his front foot across and creams it through cover-point for a boundary. This will boost his confidence!
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
On a good length outside off, Mendis defends inside the line and gets beaten. Wicket maiden from Jasprit Bumrah! What an over, this!
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Kusal Mendis is the new man in.

OUT! Successful review! Bumrah gets his man this time! Similar to the first delivery of this over, Jasprit darts it very full around leg. Once again Dickwella fails to dig it out and is rapped low on the pads. The Indians start appealing but this time the umpire stays put. Dhoni looks confident and urges Kohli to take the review, who obliges. The Hawk Eye shows it to be pitching in line and going on to hit the stumps. Second successful review in the over. Dickwella has to walk back and this is an early blow for the Islanders.
A similar ball from Bumrah to the previous lbw call. This time the umpire has declined the appeal but India have gone for the review. Looks very close!
Another slower one and another careful block from Dickwella.
Slower one from Bumrah, Dickwella watches it carefully and then blocks it away.

NOT OUT! Yes, it pitched outside leg! Yorker from Bumrah, darted onto the boots of Dickwella. He fails to dig it out and is rapped low on the back pad. The players appeal loudly and the umpire obliges. The southpaw has a discussion with his partner and then goes for the review. Ultra Edge shows that there was no involvement of the bat but Hawk Eye shows the ball to be pitching outside leg. That saves Niroshan. Good use of the review from the hosts!
Nirsohan Dickwella has been adjudged lbw. However, after a discussion with Chandimal, he has opted for the review. Has it pitched outside leg?
Just away! Back of a length delivery, angling away. Dickwella slashes at it, gets an outside edge and the ball flies past flying Rohit Sharma at gully. It races to third man and a single is taken.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

FOUR! In the gap! Short and around leg, Dickwella camps back and plays a controlled pull through backward square leg. The fine leg fielder can't cut it off and that's another boundary for the southpaw.
Slanting away from the southpaw, he slashes at it but misses.
Fuller and wide outside off, Dinesh waits for it and then dabs it to third man for a single.
Another fumble! Wide outside off, Chandimal glides it behind square on the off side. Bumrah at third man fumbles and the Lankan batsmen convert the one into a second.

Shout for lbw, turned down! Pitched on a length around leg, angling away. Dickwella fails to tuck it away and gets hit high on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire isn't interested. Height might be the question. The Hawk Eye though showed that it pitched outside leg. So a good decision, this!
Dickwella gets right behind the line of the ball and blocks it.
Angling into the batsman from a length around off. Chandimal gets half forward and works it off the inner half on the leg side. A single is taken and Dinesh is off the mark with that.
Back of a length delivery, angling away, punched off the back foot behind square on the off side for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
On a length, straying on the pads, Dickwella just flicks it over mid-wicket. The fielder from the ring chases it down and keeps the batsmen down to a brace.
Jasprit Bumrah to bowl with the second new ball from the other end.
Outside off, left alone. Good first over for Sri Lanka!
Angling into the pads, Chandimal shimmies across to clip but misses. This time the ball brushes the pads and rolls towards Dhoni.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
On a good length around off, seams in a touch. Chandimal prods ahead to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Wide! Angling down leg, Chandimal shuffles across to flick but misses and a wide is signalled.
This time Jadhav collects the ball. Similar ball and once again Dickwella throws his bat to it. Once again it's towards Jadhav at third man, who fields this time and keeps it down to one.

FOUR! Sloppy from Kedar Jadhav! Wide outside off, slanting away. Dickwella plays away from the body. Throws his bat to it and gets it towards third man. Jadhav there, hares to his right, slides in to stop but fumbles and the ball trickles away to the fence. Kohli won't be happy with this start.

The players are out in the middle. NIROSHAN DICKWELLA and DINESH CHANDIMAL to open for Sri Lanka. BHUVNESHWAR KUMAR to operate with the first new ball. A couple of slips in place for him. Here we go...

Virat Kohli says that he would have bowled first. Informs that they were rocked in the last game by an bowler unknown to them and adds that it was a good learning from them. Mentions that they wanted to have a total on board and chase. Adds that they were quite relaxed as they can't do much from the outside but just back the guys in the middle. On that game he further adds that it was one of the bizarre games he has ever witnessed in his ODI career. Ends by saying that there are no changes to his side.

Chamara Kapugedera says that the mood is pretty good. Informs that they fought hard but failed to step over the line. However, he mentions that the motivation is good. Mentions that they have spoken about the over-rate in the team meeting and have certain plans for it. Informs the two changes - LAHIRU THIRIMANNE and DINESH CHANDIMAL come in for the suspended Tharanga and injured Gunathilaka.
TOSS - Sri Lanka win their first toss in the series. They opt to bat first.

PITCH REPORT - Zaheer Khan and Russell Arnold inspecting the pitch say that today's match will be played a couple of strips further from the previous match but nothing much has changed. Add that it's a nice and firm track with a tinge of grass on one end which the fast bowlers would look to make use of it. They inform that as we have seen in the last few ODIs, there isn't much swing on offer but the bowlers will get help off the seam. Ends by saying it's a good toss to lose.

Sri Lanka will be without their regular skipper Upul Tharanga after he was handed a 2-game ban. Chamara Kapugedera will captain the side in his absence, 20th ODI skipper for the Islanders. The hosts will hope that it bring change in luck as it's a do or die game for them. It's overcast already and passing showers have been predicted throughout the day. Let's hope that it stays away and we have an undisturbed game.

Hello everyone to a beautiful Sunday afternoon. It's a great weekend for the cricketing fans around the world as we have three international games lined up for you. One of them is the third ODI between Sri Lanka and India. The Men in Blue have taken a 2-0 lead in the 5-match series and will look to seal the deal today itself with yet another victory.
